chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibrāhīm al-Hamadhānī, who raises it to Abū ʿAbd Allāh (عليه السلام), regarding His, the Exalted's, saying:
And We will set up the equitable scales for the Day of Resurrection.
He said: “The Prophets and the successors (عليهم السلام).”

key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءُ: the successors or legatees appointed after the Prophets
key_terms.الْمَوَازِينَ: the scales by which deeds or realities are weighed
key_terms.لِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ: for the Day of Resurrection and final reckoning

ai.seo_question: Who are the equitable scales mentioned in the verse about the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase about the equitable scales on the Day of Resurrection as referring to the Prophets and the successors (عليهم السلام). Its significance is that they are presented as the divinely appointed معيار by which truth, justice, and human standing are known.
